worldcombat.skill.noretreat.summary: A roar that drives every ounce of strength into the body while the feet are planted in the ground: Attack, Defence, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed each +1, but the user cannot move for the duration. It cannot be sworn twice, and low health makes standing pinned under a foe's blade a bad trade.
worldcombat.skill.noretreat.use.0: Raise your stats once close to the target, then stand and fight
worldcombat.skill.noretreat.use.1: Trade one all-stat surge for a last stretch of damage when cornered
worldcombat.skill.noretreat.use.2: Pair with an ally's control so the stance window lands while the foe cannot leave
The user cannot move for about %1$s after casting.
The all-in variant raises all five stat stages; the swift variant raises Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed.
Wind-up %1$s, recovery %2$s, cooldown %3$s; it cannot be sworn again while one is already active.
worldcombat.skill.noretreat.option.on: Skirmish: only Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed rise, the oath lasts half as long and the cooldown is x0.75 — quick to throw and quick to leave, but the defences are given up.
worldcombat.skill.noretreat.option.off: All-in: all five stats +1, held longer with a longer cooldown — a full surge, but pinned longer.
worldcombat.skill.noretreat.timing: Reach %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP and cooldown %5$s from commit. The wind-up can be interrupted at no cost.
worldcombat.skill.noretreat.growth.0: From level %1$s: the oath lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.noretreat.preference.r: On (Skirmish): only Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed rise, the oath lasts half as long and the cooldown is x0.75 — quick to throw and quick to leave, but the defences are given up. Off (All-in): all five stats +1, held longer with a longer cooldown — a full surge, but pinned longer.
worldcombat.skill.noretreat.preference.a: The partner only swears the oath while a threat is this close; larger tops up earlier and risks pinning itself before it reaches the foe.
The partner will not swear below this health fraction; 0 swears even when nearly down, higher only dares to pin itself near full health.
